comparison.objective: Commission an adjustable shock absorber vs set two power-rack safety arms to the correct bench-press notch.
comparison.physical_skill: Hex-bit engagement, bounded fastening, fine collar rotation, socket reacquisition, and response-driven iteration vs sliding and matching two safety-arm heights.
comparison.success_condition: Two non-bottoming, force-bounded cycles with no collar drift vs both safety arms at 7–8 cm, level, and not below the chest-safety threshold.
comparison.reason: Both alter safety hardware settings, but the rack task tests discrete bilateral height placement; it does not test locking or dynamic energy absorption.
